results.title: UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara ends after 35 years
results.content: The United Nations's peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara ceased operations on Sunday, after the Security Council failed to extend its mandate.

results.title: China excludes La Liga matches from broadcast schedule after Mbappé’s Mao remarks
results.content: China has followed through on its threat: state broadcaster CCTV did not air the first two La Liga matches of the weekend after Kylian Mbappé’s remarks about Mao Zedong.

results.title: Iran proposes two-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
results.content: Iran has agreed to a "two-day plan" to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, shortening its earlier seven-day proposal, Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi said on Sunday, as an Iranian delegation continues talks with mediators in Qatar.

results.title: TPLF loses popular support after fresh fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray
results.content: The Tigray People's Liberation Front was once Ethiopia's ruling party, but the movement is now facing a backlash from former supporters in the region.

results.title: Israel’s first ambassador presents credentials in Somaliland
results.content: Israel’s first ambassador to Somaliland has presented his credentials to President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, known as Cirro, in Hargeisa. The ceremony also marked the laying of the cornerstone for an Israeli embassy.

results.title: Israeli right-wing activists protest possible Arab coalition
results.content: A few dozen right-wing activists gathered outside Gadi Eisenkot’s residence in Herzliya on Sunday to protest against the Israeli-Arab coalition in the new government.

results.title: Senegal’s Olympic Games face cost-of-living concerns
results.content: The 2026 Dakar Youth Olympics are bringing Africa’s first Olympic event to Senegal, but for many residents, the excitement is overshadowed by rising living costs and lost livelihoods.

results.title: Spain’s El Hierro grapples with rising migrant arrivals
results.content: Nearly 3,000 migrants have reached the island of El Hierro, in Spain’s Canary Islands, since the beginning of October. The small Atlantic island, home to around 11,000 people, is facing a sharp increase in arrivals along the Atlantic migration route.

results.title: In Lome, a soviet-era sport celebrates Togo-Russia ties
results.content: Sambo began in the USSR and takes its name from a Russian expression meaning "unarmed self-defense"

results.title: Hundreds march in Johannesburg to celebrate LGBTQ+ pride in South Africa
results.content: Hundreds of people took to the streets of Sandton on Saturday to celebrate South Africa’s Pride parade, one of Africa’s largest annual celebrations of inclusivity

results.title: Africa suffering in 'strongmen' era: governance watchdog Mo Ibrahim
results.content: The Mo Ibrahim Foundation's latest report, finds broad progress on economic opportunity and human development over the past decade, but also steep declines in security, human rights and public participation

results.title: Migrants find shelter in Cyprus as EU slows admissions
results.content: Most migrants arrived from Somalia, Sudan, Yemen, Cameroon, Congo, Syria and Burundi, according to center officials

results.title: Youth Olympics open in Senegal marking the first Olympic event in Africa
results.content: The Youth Olympic Games opened in Senegal on Saturday, marking the first Olympic event in Africa as the continent seeks a bigger role in international sports competitions

results.title: Cape Verde president rallies supporters as campaigns kick off
results.content: Hundreds of Supporters of Cape Verde President Jose Maria Neves cheered him on at a rally in Sao Vicente, as campaigning in the country's presidential election kicked off on Saturday

results.title: Ebola deaths top 5,000 as fear of continent-wide spread mounts
results.content: Deaths in Congo’s Ebola outbreak have topped 5,000 as the country grapples with the relentless spread of the disease and cases are recorded in other African countries, the latest government data on Saturday shows

results.title: 2,000 Salvadoran troops take quarters in Haiti to help fight gangs
results.content: The deployment followed a gang attack on four Salvadoran members of the Gang Suppression Force who went missing

results.content: About 2,700 young athletes aged 14 to 17 will compete through Nov. 13 in the capital, Dakar, the nearby city of Diamniadio and the beach resort of Saly

results.title: Tshisekedi seeks Putin's help against Rwanda-backed rebels
results.content: President Felix Tshisekedi said he "absolutely" wanted the help of Russia, a permanent UN Security Council member "in the search for peace" with Rwanda, during talks with Putin at the end of a Russia-Africa summit

results.title: South African court sets limits on anti-migrant marches

results.title: Drone strikes in Ethiopia kill at least 25: witnesses
results.content: Multiple drone strikes have hit northern regions of Ethiopia since Thursday, killing at least 25 civilians, including children, witnesses and a medical source said on Friday

results.title: Ghana in talks with Russia for first nuclear power plant
results.content: Russian President Vladimir Putin met his Ghanaian counterpart John Dramani Mahama for bilateral talks the next day after Russia-Africa summit in Moscow

results.title: Guinean cinema: A new generation strives to bring the industry back to life

results.title: President Ruto seeks compensation for Kenyans recruited into Russian military
results.content: An investigation by Journalists for Justice, published earlier this month, identified at least 76 Kenyans killed while fighting for Russia, alongside 841 Kenyan nationals recruited between October 2022 and June 2026.

results.title: Tanzania still haunted by deadly election violence one year on
results.content: One year after Tanzania’s disputed election, the scars of deadly violence remain. Critics still live in fear of abductions and arrests, while opposition supporters continue to face intimidation.

results.title: Lagos Fashion Week returns for 15th edition with a commitment to sustainability
results.content: Lagos fashion week is back - returning this week for its 15th edition. This year's event is focused on circularity and sustainability - and ensuring African creators reap the benefits of their work.

results.title: Egyptian Red Crescent sends flour and winter supplies to Gaza
results.content: Egypt has sent an aid convoy of 62 trucks carrying more than 780 tonnes of relief supplies to Gaza, ahead of the winter season.

results.title: Gunfire heard across Ethiopia border as growing numbers flee into Kenya
results.content: Gunfire echoes across the Ethiopia-Kenya border in Moyale, as violence drives thousands to flee into Kenya. The clashes stem from a territorial dispute between Ethiopia’s Oromia and Somali regions.

results.title: Pakistan: Islamabad zoo introduces 'Coffee with Alpaca' attraction
results.content: Coffee with a side of alpacas? At a zoo near Islamabad, visitors can enjoy drinks and snacks while watching, feeding and petting the animals. The attraction features ten imported alpacas, a first for Pakistan according to the zoo.

results.title: Poor services and crime fuel voter frustration ahead of South Africa’s polls
results.content: South Africans head to the polls next week, with basic services, crime and unemployment among the key issues shaping the local elections.

results.title: First body recovered from Nairobi building collapse as 16 remain missing
results.content: A first body was recovered Friday from the rubble of an 18-storey building that collapsed a week ago in Nairobi, as 16 people remain missing.
